candidates_without_duplicate_credit.title: Incident recovery UI state may be published after a newer identity or lifecycle fence

deduplication.reason: Both workers independently traced the same NativeIncidentSession restore/retire post-await generation fence gap; W5 reviewed the recovery resolution dependency, W2 the session file. One P2 candidate, not two.
deduplication.prior_C009_native_candidate: C009-NATIVE-001 concerns false verification UI label in release view and is a distinct source path.

findings.title: Incident recovery UI state may be published after a newer identity or lifecycle fence
findings.preconditions: An in-flight observeRecoveryContext resolves the actor-bound restore and passes generation check at line 70; applyNativeIncidentRecoveryRestore then waits for recovery.clearResolved during a RETIRED or UNKNOWN resolution. While that awaited operation is unresolved, identity purge/fence or a newer context increments generation and publishes a new state. Once the old clearResolved finishes, observeRecoveryContext at lines 76-77 sets marker/publishes an old result without checking generation again. Likewise retire() verifies generation before its second awaited resolution step but not after; acknowledge() awaits clearResolved then publishes inactive without any generation guard, potentially overwriting a newer context.
findings.impact: Stale incident recovery status/marker can reappear or a newer recovery view can be hidden after identity or location change. The demonstrated RETIRED/UNKNOWN path carries status without incident description; no server-side tenant access or protected mutation bypass has been established. Possible more sensitive FOUND snapshot race is less certain because that branch has no storage await.
findings.existing_mitigations: Initial generation fence after restore (line 70), canonical server actor/session/location bound recovery result, serialized local storage operations, identity purge (auth/native-auth-runtime.ts:238-254), strict no-replay policy and independent server authorization; these reduce likelihood/impact but do not fence the final in-memory publication.
findings.counterevidence: Existing native-incident-marker-submit-fence.test.ts covers a pending marker write versus purge; native-contextual-lifecycle-fences.test.ts tests slow legacy GET/POST; native-incident-recovery-boundaries.test.ts verifies process-death recovery. None observed in static read schedules identity invalidation during awaited applyNativeIncidentRecoveryResolution clearResolved and checks post-generation publication. Race not run and no exploit confirmed.
findings.suggested_validation: Add deterministic deferred clearResolved test: start restore with RETIRED outcome, hold clearResolved, invoke fenceRecovery/purgeRecovery or newer context, then release and assert state stays fenced/new; similarly hold retire/acknowledge clearResolved. Require a generation recheck after all awaited steps before writing marker/publishing.

findings.title: Native Incident recovery may republish a pre-purge result after identity generation changes
findings.preconditions: A recovery restore or explicit retire passes its generation check, waits for an asynchronous resolution/clearResolved, and identity purge or newer context increments generation and clears the session before the older continuation resumes.
findings.impact: The continuation assigns marker/snapshot and publishes without a second generation check. A stale retired/unknown recovery state could replace the inactive/new-identity snapshot; a narrowly timed FOUND completion could expose an old incident receipt in the local session state. The server still enforces actor-bound Incident access.
findings.existing_mitigations: Generation is checked immediately after transport.restore and before resolution work; IdentityState awaits purgeRecovery, portable storage operations are serialized, and server responses are checked against the actor-bound marker. These controls reduce the window but do not protect the post-await publish.
findings.requested_validation: A deterministic deferred clearResolved/read completion test with concurrent NativeIncidentSession.purgeRecovery or scope switch, asserting that no pre-purge result is published after identity generation changes.
findings.coverage_note: native-incident-session.ts and runtime callbacks inspected only as dependencies; they are not counted as W5 roster full-file coverage.

limitation: P2 Incident race remains medium-confidence source hypothesis until deterministic deferred-clear interleaving and physical native behavior are tested. No new P0/P1 confirmed by the presently available candidates; historical SEC-011/#363 remains separately reported in C010.
